name: @omp/hackbrowser

scripts.build: bun build crawl.ts --target node --format esm --outfile dist/crawl.mjs --external playwright --external playwright-core && bun build session-bot.ts --target node --format esm --outfile dist/session-bot.mjs --external playwright --external playwright-core
scripts.build:crawl: bun build crawl.ts --target node --format esm --outfile dist/crawl.mjs --external playwright --external playwright-core
